text:
emily: anyone else seeing a 10x spike in 429s for a handful of enterprise orgs since ~00:15 UTC? :eyes:
samir: yes, alerting showed a correlated jump in per-org throttles. looks like orgs tagged `legacy` are hit hardest.
infra-bot: Config change detected: `token_saver.policy` set to `aggressive` for selector=org.tag:legacy by console.user=jen at 00:12 UTC. change_id=cfg-2027-06-10-1423
jen: that was me — I pushed a rollout to test the new token-saver profile for low-cost tiers. I scoped to `legacy` but maybe selector matched more orgs than intended.
hao: can you paste the selector you used? we have a known bug where `org.tag:*legacy*` matches substrings.
jen: oof thought I used `org.tag==legacy` but console auto-translated to a wildcard matcher. here's the change snippet:
```
route_policy: token_saver
selector: org.tag:legacy
policy_params:
  burst_floor: 0
  bump_window_ms: 100
```
emily: burst_floor=0 is basically removing burst headroom for orgs, so short spikes turn into immediate 429s. that explains it.
dave_oncall: affected customers reporting 429s on small batch inference. page went out. I'm rolling a hotfix to revert the rollout.
samir: rollback command ready: `./console rollback-change cfg-2027-06-10-1423 --scope legacy --force`
dave_oncall: running it now.
infra-bot: Rollback started for change_id=cfg-2027-06-10-1423 by dave_oncall at 00:28 UTC
jen: on a separate note i'll open a console UX ticket — the selector UI needs clearer semantics (exact vs pattern) and a confirmation when policy will reduce burst_floor to 0.
hao: we should also make a safety check in the enforcer: reject burst_floor < min_default unless explicitly approved by SRE.
emily: agree. postmortem items: 1) revert is in flight, 2) add pre-flight guard in enforcer, 3) console UX update, 4) audit policy-change logs to see how many orgs matched.
samir: seeing 429s drop already in stacks for the orgs that were most impacted. nice. :thumbsup:
jen: apologies, will follow up with RCA and a runbook update.
infra-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 00:37 UTC. change_id=cfg-2027-06-10-1423 status=rolled_back
emily: closing loop — open a tiny oncall task to watch for any residual token_cache evictions next 2 hours.
dave_oncall: added watcher and will keep the page open for 90 minutes.
jen: thanks everyone, will draft the incident doc and link here. :pray:
